title: At Onement (Miniature VI for solo clarinet)
program_note: At Onement (Miniature VI for Clarinet), completed in May, 1993, to an extent represents a culmination of the previous five pieces.  The mate­rial for this highly virtuosic work is drawn in part from  All  at One Point (Miniature V for Marimba), the woodwind sextet Kapporot, and a traditional Jewish Yom Kippur prayer.  “Kappo­rot” and “Kippur” both come from a similar root meaning “atonement;” in mood, then, this piece is a mixture of ex­uberance and peni­tence.
